about: Spot values (PLAN 4.4 step 4): figures published by someone other than this project, which the engine step of every release run compares with what it holds. Each names a Series, a Period, the published value and how far the held value may be from it; the tolerance is half a unit of the last digit published unless it says why not. A spot whose Series or Period is not in the Release is reported as not checked. A spot that is off fails the run. These are expectations, not data: nothing here is published.

spots.source: BLS, Consumer Price Index June 2022 (USDL-22-1470, 13 July 2022): all items rose 9.1 percent over the 12 months, before seasonal adjustment
